Odisha Student Union Polls Cancelled Amid Violence, Allegations

Student union elections in Odisha have been cancelled following crude bomb blasts at a college, leading to its closure. The Biju Janata Dal (BJD) has alleged that the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) favored certain candidates, violating Lyngdoh Committee norms during the polls. The BJD accused the BJP of favoritism in the student union elections.
